story.title: When an Eagle Owl Hybrid Flees a Black Hole
story.signature_move: It hovers silently above the abyss before dropping its broad tail fan to brake instantly over prey.
story.hybrid_look: The creature has a round, upright, feathered body and feathered legs ending in talons from the owl, matched with an eagle-shaped head, the owl's eyes, bird wings, and a broad tail fan.

sentences.text: It takes one person every night, never forgetting who was counted last.

sentences.text: Meet Aethel, an imaginary hybrid combining an eagle's head and wings with an owl's round body and eyes.
sentences.image: cracked obsidian plates floating in the heavy vacuum of a deep space chasm
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The hybrid hovers off the ground, then beats its wings to snatch event-horizon gulls from the edge.
sentences.image: shimmering gravitational waves rippling across a dark horizon of crushed star dust
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: A massive shadow surges upward from the void, hunting it for breaking the cosmic count.
sentences.image: a towering wall of crushing dark matter swallowing distant glowing star clusters
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: I watched the great pursuer close in while jagged space debris rained down all around.
sentences.image: shards of frozen methane tumbling through a freezing, silent gravitational rift
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: It tries to dive fast using its eagle wings, but the intense gravity pulls it right back.

sentences.text: Then its silent owl feathers let it vanish completely into the dark, saving its life.

sentences.text: It fears absolute silence above all else. What should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
